job.title: [Post] We're Hiring | Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Developer NESTOSH LLC is looking for ... SFCC…

tailoring.headline: B2C Commerce Cloud Developer | SAP Commerce (Hybris) | Java, Spring, REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale B2C e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs, microservices and headless commerce. Proven record of designing PIM-ERP-MDM integrations, CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes deployments and providing techno-functional analysis for international stakeholders.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited by NESTOSH LLC’s focus on cutting-edge B2C commerce solutions. With over five years building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in headless commerce, API design and large-scale integrations that align perfectly with your Salesforce B2C goals.

bullets.label: Techno-functional expertise
bullets.text: Led end-to-end SAP Commerce projects, translating business requirements into functional specifications and delivering robust B2C solutions for global customers.

bullets.label: API integration
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST web services and integrated PIM/ERP/MDM data pipelines, ensuring seamless product and catalog synchronization across channels.

bullets.label: Headless commerce
bullets.text: Implemented headless APIs for storefronts and third-party consumers, enabling flexible front-end experiences and rapid time-to-market.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Cloud delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) using Docker and Kubernetes, guaranteeing reliable releases in agile environments.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026 – I welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.

tailoring.why_company: NESTOSH LLC’s reputation for delivering innovative B2C commerce experiences on the Salesforce platform aligns with my passion for building scalable, headless e-commerce solutions. I am eager to bring my proven SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, strong API integration background, and AI-assisted development approach to accelerate your clients’ digital transformation and drive measurable business outcomes.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my 5+ years of B2C commerce expertise to help NESTOSH LLC create high-performance, API-driven e-commerce experiences that exceed client expectations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of B2C e-commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m keen to discuss how my API and integration skills can support NESTOSH LLC’s Salesforce B2C initiatives. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Developer
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Developer role. With over five years of hands-on experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to NESTOSH LLC’s success.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for the position.
